string.name: network_permission_reason
string.value: Needs network permission to get network information and send magic packet

string.name: help_info
string.value:
- This application only support magic packet Wake-on-LAN.
- Click refresh button (the circle arrow with Wi-Fi symbol in it on the right upper corner) can refresh current broadcast address, which is calculated by this device's Wi-Fi IP address and netmask.

About Wake-on-LAN/Magic Packet: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wake-on-LAN
Broadcast Address: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Broadcast_address
